'''Koh-Lanta: Cambodge''' ({{translation|Koh-Lanta: Cambodia}}) is the 17th season of the [[France|French]] version of [[Survivor (franchise)|Survivor]], [[Koh-Lanta]]. This season takes place in [[Koh Rong]], [[Cambodia]] in the same location in which the previous season, [[Koh-Lanta: L'Île au Trésor]] was filmed. The main twist this season is instead of having the two traditional tribes, there are three in this season.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.telestar.fr/tele-realite/koh-lanta/cambodge/koh-lanta-cambodge-decouvrez-les-nouveaux-candidats-de-l-edition-2017-266353|title=Koh-Lanta Cambodge : voici les 18 nouveaux candidats de l'édition 2017 ! [Photos]|first=Nathalie|last=Vigneau|date=February 15, 2017|website=Télé Star}}</ref> In addition on day 4, three contestants were added to the game; one for each tribe. The season premiered on 10 March 2017 & concluded on 16 June 2017 where Frédéric Blancher won in a 6-2 jury vote against Clémentine Jullien to be crowned the Sole Survivor.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ozap.com/actu/-koh-lanta-cambodge-la-finale-le-resume-de-l-emission-en-direct/530089|title="Koh-Lanta Cambodge", la finale : "Ils sont très, très remontés contre Clémentine"|first=Charles|last=Decant|date=June 16, 2017|website=PureMédias}}</ref>

== Future appearances ==
Clémentine Jullien, Dylan Thiry and Yassin Metiri later returned for ''[[Koh-Lanta: Le Combat des Héros]]''. Clémentine returned for a third time for ''[[Koh-Lanta: La Légende]]'', and for a fourth time for ''[[Koh-Lanta: All Stars]]'' alongside Yassin.
